title: First-Token Attraction in Mamba Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2611.08303v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study token dynamics in deep Mamba models, with a particular focus on the attracting role of the first token. Unlike attention mechanisms, where token interactions are governed by positive scalar coefficients, Mamba dynamics involve full matrix-valued interaction coefficients with no positivity or definiteness guarantees. This structural difference makes Mamba dynamics substantially harder to analyze and prevents the direct application of existing techniques for attention-based models. To overcome this challenge, we introduce a new analytical framework based on a high-dimensional invariant box and a sharp exit-time argument, which together recover an effective form of sign-definiteness. Using this framework, we characterize the possible limit points of token trajectories and prove explicit exponential convergence rates. Our analysis reveals that the first token has privileged dynamics: its limiting direction attracts subsequent tokens

translated_title: Mamba动力学中的首Token吸引效应
translated_abstract: 我们研究深度Mamba模型中的token动力学，特别关注第一个token所起的吸引作用。与注意力机制不同——注意力机制中token之间的交互由正标量系数控制——Mamba动力学涉及完整的矩阵值交互系数，且不保证其正性或定性。这种结构上的差异使得Mamba动力学的分析难度大大增加，也使得针对基于注意力模型的现有技术无法直接套用。为克服这一挑战，我们引入了一个新的分析框架，该框架基于高维不变盒子和一个精确的退出时间论证，二者结合共同恢复了一种有效的符号定性形式。利用该框架，我们刻画了token轨迹所有可能的极限点，并证明了显式的指数收敛速率。我们的分析揭示了第一个token具有特权动力学特性：其极限方向会吸引后续的token。
tldr: 该论文提出基于高维不变盒子与精确退出时间论证的新分析框架，首次刻画了深度Mamba模型中token轨迹的极限点并证明指数收敛速率，揭示首个token的极限方向会吸引后续token这一特权动力学特性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a new analytical framework based on a high-dimensional invariant box and a sharp exit-time argument to characterize limit points of token trajectories in deep Mamba models, proving explicit exponential convergence rates and revealing that the first token's limiting direction attracts subsequent tokens.
